Local manual baseline
Provide local enable/disable controls, visible operating indication and lockable maintenance isolation.
Demonstrate local start/enable, stop/disable and restoration without unintended re-energisation.
Remote supervisory operation
Add isolated remote command and run/ready/fault feedback terminals; define local/remote priority.
Test conflicting commands, local priority and remote cable interruption.
Scheduled operation
Add a time-switch enable path, manual override and schedule-state indication.
Test scheduled transitions, override expiry and clock recovery.
Demand-controlled enable
Add a demand sensor or dry-contact interface with adjustable threshold and hysteresis.
Test threshold crossing, sensor failure and stable recovery.
Supply undervoltage supervision
Add supply-monitoring contacts and a defined loss-of-voltage inhibit path.
Test undervoltage inhibit and documented restart policy.
Phase and supply-quality supervision
Provide a supply-monitor interface; for single-phase cases monitor voltage/frequency rather than inventing phases.
Test declared supply faults and contact fail state.
Individual branch metering
Add separate metering channels to two identified outgoing circuits with protected sensing interfaces.
Verify meter channel assignment, polarity and energy reconciliation.
Whole-system energy reporting
Add incomer metering, communications isolation and a register/address schedule.
Compare indicated energy direction with a declared reference and test loss of communications.
Two-zone operation
Divide controllable outputs into two independently isolated operating zones.
Verify independent operation and that isolation of one zone leaves the other correctly defined.
Three-stage load sequencing
Add three controlled enable stages with adjustable delays and stage feedback.
Test sequence timing, failed-stage response and restart order.
Priority load shedding
Classify outgoing loads into essential and deferrable groups and add a staged shedding interface.
Test demand limit, shedding order and controlled reconnection.
Buffered control power
Add a control-power buffer interface, health contact and protected control branches.
Test supply interruption, hold-up requirement and orderly recovery.
Redundant control-power inputs
Provide two isolated control-power sources through a documented decoupling interface.
Test loss of each source, alarm response and prevention of backfeed.
Environmental temperature supervision
Add cabinet temperature sensing, high-temperature alarm and a documented inhibit interface.
Test warning threshold, inhibit threshold and sensor open circuit.
Condensation management
Add hygrostat/heater control, protective separation and heater status feedback.
Test humidity demand and operation while the primary process is disabled.
Door and enclosure supervision
Add enclosure-door contact inputs, access indication and a defined access response.
Test contact opening, bypass authorisation and return to normal operation.
Maintenance test mode
Add keyed test selection and segregated test terminals; prevent test commands reaching unintended outputs.
Prove mode indication, command isolation and return to service.
Remote alarm annunciation
Add common alarm, common warning and healthy contacts with fail-state definitions.
Test loss of control power, individual faults, reset and remote contact behaviour.
First-out fault capture
Add individually identified fault inputs and first-event latching/reset logic.
Inject ordered faults and verify retained initiating cause and reset conditions.
Event and operating-hour logging
Provide event counter and operating-hour interfaces with retention requirements.
Test counter rollover policy, power-loss retention and reset access.
Ethernet supervisory gateway
Add an industrial gateway supply, port schedule and network-boundary documentation.
Test link loss, stale data indication and continued defined local operation.
Serial supervisory gateway
Add isolated RS-485 interface terminals, shield termination and address/termination schedules.
Test address uniqueness, bus termination and communications failure state.
Hardwired permissive chain
Add three individually labelled external permissives with diagnostic test points.
Open each permissive and verify the specified inhibit and reset behaviour.
Controlled shutdown interface
Add a plant shutdown input and ordered deactivation outputs; distinguish operational stop from safety functions.
Test shutdown order, residual-energy documentation and restart authorisation.
Commissioning simulation terminals
Add removable simulation links and isolated test inputs with normal-service link positions.
Verify simulated faults without energising field loads and audit restored link positions.
Modular field connections
Replace selected fixed field terminations with keyed connector interfaces and a pin-assignment schedule.
Verify mating compatibility, PE continuity where applicable and prevention of swapped connections.
Distributed field enclosure
Move identified field terminals into a second enclosure with an interconnecting cable schedule.
Verify end-to-end terminal mapping, screen continuity and cross-enclosure isolation boundaries.
Future expansion provision
Provide a defined additional outgoing circuit and reserved control/terminal capacity with load allowance.
Validate reserved space, protective-device coordination assumptions and available supply capacity.
Supply restoration management
Add manual acknowledgement or delayed automatic restoration according to the documented operating risk.
Test short and extended outages, acknowledgement and prevention of unexpected actuation.
Integrated diagnostics package
Combine branch status feedback, supply-health monitoring and a structured diagnostic terminal strip.
Inject branch/supply faults and verify unique fault identification at the handover interface.
